get.summary: Authorized by the route (`can:view,order`)

put.summary:
Changes a Pending or Confirmed Order's lines, addresses and Shipping method, adjusting
its reservations. A Locked order is refused with 409 `order_locked`. Safe to retry
with an `Idempotency-Key` header

post.summary:
Moves the Order one step forward (Preparing, Ready for shipping). A skipped or
backward move is refused with 409 `invalid_transition` and `details.allowed`. Safe
to retry with an `Idempotency-Key` header

get.summary: The Users an Order may be assigned to. Authorized by the route (orders.assign)

put.summary: Sets (or clears, with null) the Order's Assignee, who is notified in their bell

post.summary:
Cancels the whole Order and releases any Reserved stock. Safe to retry with an
`Idempotency-Key` header

Confirms a Pending Order and reserves its stock. Authorized by the route
(`can:confirm,order`); safe to retry with an `Idempotency-Key` header

Partial cancellation: cancels some units of some lines before the Order ships,
releasing their stock and re-pricing the Order. Safe to retry with an
`Idempotency-Key` header
Adds a note to the Order's timeline (Locked orders too) and answers with the Order

Records a payment. A declined Card charge is still recorded (status `failed`) and
answered with 201; a payment above the amount still due is refused with 409
`payment_exceeds_due`

Prices lines before the Order exists (VAT per line, shipping, total) and lists each
active Warehouse with the lines it lacks stock for. A Coupon code is applied when it is
valid; otherwise `coupon` gives the reason. Nothing is saved

Above the Captured amount minus earlier Refunds it is refused with 409
`refund_exceeds_captured`

post.summary:
Ships some units of a Ready for shipping Order. The Order becomes Shipped once
everything left has shipped. Refused with 409 `order_not_ready_for_shipping` in any
other status; a quantity above what the line has left to ship is a 422. Safe to retry
with an `Idempotency-Key` header

its Shipments are delivered. A delivered Shipment is refused with 409
`invalid_shipment_transition`. Safe to retry with an `Idempotency-Key` header

AdjustmentReason.description: Why an Adjustment corrected stock. Values are stored, so cases are never renamed.
AdjustmentReason.title: AdjustmentReason

AdvanceOrderRequest.description:
The status to move an Order forward to: Preparing or Ready for shipping. Whether that is
the Order's next step is the Order flow's decision (409 `invalid_transition`).
AdvanceOrderRequest.title: AdvanceOrderRequest

AssignOrderRequest.description:
The Order's new Assignee (an active Admin, Operations or Sales User), or null to leave
it unassigned.
AssignOrderRequest.title: AssignOrderRequest

AuditAction.description:
What a User did to a record, as kept in the audit trail. Values are stored, so cases are added (status changes, Refunds…) but never renamed or removed. | | |---| | `created`
| | `updated`
| | `deleted`
| | `password_changed`
A User's password was replaced; the trail never stores password values. | | `status_changed`
A record moved to another status (an Order Confirmed, Cancelled…). |
AuditAction.title: AuditAction

CancelOrderLinesRequest.description:
Partial cancellation: how many units of which of the Order's lines (each line once),
with an optional reason added to the timeline.
CancelOrderLinesRequest.title: CancelOrderLinesRequest

CancelOrderRequest.description: Cancelling an Order, with an optional reason kept in its status history.
CancelOrderRequest.title: CancelOrderRequest

CardTestOutcome.description: The test option the mock Card gateway decides by: approve or decline the charge. It stands in for the card details a real gateway would collect; none are ever taken.
CardTestOutcome.title: CardTestOutcome

ChangePasswordRequest.description:
A User replacing their own password: they must know the current one, and the new
one must meet the minimum strength ({@see Password::defaults()}).
ChangePasswordRequest.title: ChangePasswordRequest

CouponType.description: How a Coupon discounts an Order: a percentage of the eligible lines, or a fixed amount (never more than the eligible lines are worth).
CouponType.title: CouponType

DecideReturnRequest.description: Approving or rejecting a Requested Return, with an optional note (returns.approve).
DecideReturnRequest.title: DecideReturnRequest

DeductionStage.description: The Order status at which Reserved units leave On-hand, chosen in Settings. The values are the matching Order statuses, so the Order flow can compare the two directly.
DeductionStage.title: DeductionStage

GenerateVariantsRequest.description:
The Attribute values to generate a Product's Variants from (any number per
Attribute). An empty list makes the single Variant of a Product without Attributes.
GenerateVariantsRequest.title: GenerateVariantsRequest

Locale.description: The interface languages. Arabic is read right to left.
Locale.title: Locale

OrderStatus.description: Where an Order is in its life. It moves forward one step at a time (Pending → Confirmed → Preparing → Ready for shipping → Shipped → Delivered) and may be Cancelled any time before it is Shipped. This enum is the one place the allowed moves are defined; actions ask {@see canMoveTo()} before changing a status.
OrderStatus.title: OrderStatus

PaymentKind.description: A Payment ledger row either takes money in (payment) or gives it back (Refund).
PaymentKind.title: PaymentKind

PaymentMethod.description: How a Customer pays: Cash on delivery, Manual (bank transfer or cash), or Card through the mock Payment gateway (App\Contracts\PaymentGateway).
PaymentMethod.title: PaymentMethod

PaymentOutcome.description: Whether a Payment ledger row moved money. Only a Card charge the gateway declines is Failed; it stays in the ledger but counts toward nothing.
PaymentOutcome.title: PaymentOutcome

ProductBulkAction.description:
What the Products list can do to several Products at once. | | |---| | `activate`
| | `archive`
| | `delete`
Deletes the Products that may be deleted and skips the ones on Orders. |
ProductBulkAction.title: ProductBulkAction

ProductBulkActionRequest.description: One action (activate, archive or delete) on up to a page of Products.
ProductBulkActionRequest.title: ProductBulkActionRequest

ProductStatus.description: Where a Product stands in the catalog. A Product that appears on any Order can be Archived but never deleted.
ProductStatus.title: ProductStatus

QuoteOrderRequest.description:
The lines of an Order being filled in, and optionally its Shipping method, Coupon code
and Customer (for the Coupon's per-Customer limit), to quote. Open to Roles that create
Orders.
QuoteOrderRequest.title: QuoteOrderRequest

RefundReturnRequest.description:
Completing a Return with its Refund (refunds.issue): the amount (zero completes it
without one) and whether the Order's shipping is refunded too.
RefundReturnRequest.title: RefundReturnRequest

ReorderProductImagesRequest.description:
A Product's images in their new order: each of its image ids exactly once; the first
becomes the main image.
ReorderProductImagesRequest.title: ReorderProductImagesRequest

ReportType.description: The six reports; the value is the report's URL segment and file name.
ReportType.title: ReportType

RestockDecision.description: What happens to a Received Return line: back into On-hand at the Fulfilling warehouse, or a Write-off (it never re-enters stock). Values are stored.
RestockDecision.title: RestockDecision

RestockReturnRequest.description:
Restock decisions for some lines of a Received Return (returns.receive): each line
once, back into stock or a Write-off.
RestockReturnRequest.title: RestockReturnRequest

ReturnReason.description: Why the Customer sends the items back. Values are stored.
ReturnReason.title: ReturnReason

ReturnStatus.description: Where a Return is: Requested → Approved or Rejected; Approved → Received (the items arrived) → Completed (every item has its Restock decision and the Refund, if any, is recorded). This enum is the one place the allowed moves are defined.
ReturnStatus.title: ReturnStatus

Role.description: The seven fixed Roles. Every User has exactly one; this enum is the single source of the permission matrix.
Role.title: Role

SalesInterval.description: How the Sales report groups Counted orders: one row per day, per week (starting Monday) or per month, each dated by its first day.
SalesInterval.title: SalesInterval

SaveShippingMethodRequest.description:
A new or edited Shipping method in a zone: a name unique within the zone, a flat price, the
estimated delivery days (from–to) and whether it is offered. Managing a zone's
methods is part of managing the zone, so the zone's `update` ability decides.
SaveShippingMethodRequest.title: SaveShippingMethodRequest

Segment.description: An automatic grouping of Customers by buying behaviour, from their Counted orders. A Customer is in the first Segment that matches, checked in this order: New (first Order in the last 30 days), VIP (Lifetime value of $1,000 or more), At risk (no Order for 90 days), Regular (everyone else, including a Customer with no Counted order yet).
Segment.title: Segment

StockMovementType.description:
Why a Stock movement happened. Values are stored, so cases are added but never renamed or removed. Each later ticket that changes stock adds its own case. | | |---| | `receipt`
Stock arriving from a supplier (a Receipt): adds On-hand. | | `reservation`
An Order was Confirmed: its units are promised to it (adds Reserved). | | `release`
An Order holding Reserved units was cancelled: they are free again (removes Reserved). | | `deduction`
An Order reached the Deduction stage: its Reserved units leave On-hand (removes both). | | `cancellation_return`
Units deducted for an Order were cancelled before it shipped: they are back on hand. | | `adjustment`
A correction with a reason (count correction, damaged, lost, found): adds or removes On-hand. | | `transfer_out`
A sent Transfer leaving its source Warehouse: removes On-hand. | | `transfer_in`
A received Transfer arriving at its destination Warehouse: adds On-hand. | | `return_restock`
A Received Return line whose Restock decision puts it back: adds On-hand. |
StockMovementType.title: StockMovementType

StoreAdjustmentRequest.description:
An Adjustment: an active Warehouse, a Variant, a non-zero quantity (negative removes
units) and a reason. It is safe to retry with an `Idempotency-Key`.
StoreAdjustmentRequest.title: StoreAdjustmentRequest

StoreAttributeRequest.description:
An Attribute and its whole list of values, in display order. Each value has a name
and a code for generated SKUs ("Red", "RED"), both unique within the Attribute. When
editing, a value with an `id` is kept (and renamed), one without is new, and any value
left out is removed.
StoreAttributeRequest.title: StoreAttributeRequest

StoreBrandRequest.description:
A new Brand: a name and an optional slug (generated from the name when left out).
The logo has its own endpoint (BrandLogoController), so this stays plain JSON.
StoreBrandRequest.title: StoreBrandRequest

StoreCarrierRequest.description:
A new Carrier: a unique name and an optional tracking link template, an http(s) address
holding {tracking_number} where a Shipment's tracking number goes, for example
"https://www.aramex.com/track/results?ShipmentNumber={tracking_number}".
StoreCarrierRequest.title: StoreCarrierRequest

StoreCategoryRequest.description:
A new Category: a name, an optional slug (generated from the name when left out),
an optional parent and an optional description. Whether the parent may hold children
is a business rule, checked under lock by CategoryHierarchy.
StoreCategoryRequest.title: StoreCategoryRequest

StoreCouponRequest.description:
A new Coupon: a unique code (letters, digits, - and _; kept in capitals), a percentage
(up to 100) or fixed amount, a start date and optional end date, optional total and
per-Customer usage limits, a minimum order amount, and optional eligible Products and
Categories (none means every line).
StoreCouponRequest.title: StoreCouponRequest

StoreCustomerAddressRequest.description:
An address for a Customer: who receives it, where, and whether it becomes the default
billing or shipping address. The country is an ISO code ("LB"), in any case.
StoreCustomerAddressRequest.title: StoreCustomerAddressRequest

StoreCustomerNoteRequest.description: A note about a Customer, in plain text.
StoreCustomerNoteRequest.title: StoreCustomerNoteRequest

StoreCustomerRequest.description:
A new Customer: a name, an email or a phone (or both), and Tags by name. Unknown Tags
are made on the fly; the same Tag typed twice, in any case, counts once.
StoreCustomerRequest.title: StoreCustomerRequest

StoreOrderNoteRequest.description: A note on an Order's timeline, in plain text. Locked orders still take notes.
StoreOrderNoteRequest.title: StoreOrderNoteRequest

StoreOrderRequest.description:
A new Order: the Customer, two of that Customer's addresses (billing and shipping), an
active Fulfilling warehouse, a Shipping method, optional notes and Coupon code, and one line per Variant
of an Active Product. Whether the method delivers to the shipping address is checked
when the Order is priced. It is safe to retry with an `Idempotency-Key`.
StoreOrderRequest.title: StoreOrderRequest

StorePaymentRequest.description:
A payment on an Order: its Payment method and amount, with an optional note. A Card
charge also names the mock gateway's test option (approve or decline); card details are
refused outright, so none can ever be sent or stored.
StorePaymentRequest.title: StorePaymentRequest

StoreProductImagesRequest.description:
New images for a Product (multipart): PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most 2 MB each, and at
most ten per Product in all. SVG is refused, because an SVG served from our own
origin can carry scripts.
StoreProductImagesRequest.title: StoreProductImagesRequest

StoreProductRequest.description:
A Product's details. Prices are decimal strings with at most two decimals, entered
without VAT. The slug is generated from the name when left empty. Images and Variants
have their own endpoints.
StoreProductRequest.title: StoreProductRequest

StoreReceiptRequest.description:
A Receipt: an active Warehouse, the supplier's reference, optional notes, and one line
per Variant (each Variant once) with the quantity and unit cost (up to four decimals).
It is safe to retry with an `Idempotency-Key`.
StoreReceiptRequest.title: StoreReceiptRequest

StoreRefundRequest.description: A Refund on an Order: how it goes back (Payment method), how much, and an optional note.
StoreRefundRequest.title: StoreRefundRequest

StoreReturnRequest.description:
A Return request: the reason, an optional note, and how many units of which of the
Order's lines come back (each line once). Whether the Order is Delivered, inside the
Return window and has those units left to return is the Return action's decision.
StoreReturnRequest.title: StoreReturnRequest

StoreShipmentRequest.description:
A Shipment: its Carrier, tracking number (unique per Carrier) and how many units of which
of the Order's lines it carries (each line once). Whether those units are still
unshipped is the Shipment action's decision.
StoreShipmentRequest.title: StoreShipmentRequest

StoreShippingZoneRequest.description:
A new Shipping zone: a unique name and the places it covers, each a whole country
(no city) or one city in a country. A place another zone already covers is refused,
so every address matches at most one zone.
StoreShippingZoneRequest.title: StoreShippingZoneRequest

StoreStoreLogoRequest.description: The store's logo (see {@see LogoFile::rules()}). Only the Admin may change it.
StoreStoreLogoRequest.title: StoreStoreLogoRequest

StoreTransferRequest.description:
A Draft Transfer: two different active Warehouses, optional notes, and one line per
Variant (each Variant once) with a quantity. Available is checked when it is sent.
StoreTransferRequest.title: StoreTransferRequest

StoreUserRequest.description:
A new User: name, email, one Role and a temporary password the Admin hands over. The
password meets the same strength as any other ({@see Password::defaults()}); the User
changes it in their profile.
StoreUserRequest.title: StoreUserRequest

StoreWarehouseRequest.description:
A new Warehouse: a unique name, a unique short code (stored in capitals, for example
"BEY-01") and an address. It starts active unless `is_active` says otherwise.
StoreWarehouseRequest.title: StoreWarehouseRequest

TransferStatus.description: A Transfer's two steps: Draft → In transit (sent) → Received, or Draft → Cancelled.
TransferStatus.title: TransferStatus

UpdateAttributeRequest.description: An Attribute's new name and its whole new list of values.
UpdateAttributeRequest.title: UpdateAttributeRequest

UpdateBrandRequest.description: A Brand's new name and slug. An empty slug is generated again from the name.
UpdateBrandRequest.title: UpdateBrandRequest

UpdateCarrierRequest.description: A Carrier's new name and tracking link template.
UpdateCarrierRequest.title: UpdateCarrierRequest

UpdateCategoryRequest.description:
A Category's new values, all sent at once. An empty slug is generated again from the
name. The hierarchy rules (two levels, not its own parent) live in CategoryHierarchy.
UpdateCategoryRequest.title: UpdateCategoryRequest

UpdateCouponRequest.description: A Coupon's new terms. Orders that already use it keep the terms they were priced with.
UpdateCouponRequest.title: UpdateCouponRequest

UpdateCustomerRequest.description: A Customer's new details. Tags are replaced when `tags` is sent and kept otherwise.
UpdateCustomerRequest.title: UpdateCustomerRequest

UpdateOrderRequest.description:
The new lines, addresses, Shipping method and Coupon code (none removes the Coupon) of
a Pending or Confirmed Order. The
Customer and Fulfilling warehouse stay. The lines replace the Order's lines: one per
Variant, each one already on the Order or a Variant of an Active Product.
UpdateOrderRequest.title: UpdateOrderRequest

UpdatePreferencesRequest.description:
The signed-in User's own language and theme. Every User may change their own, so
being signed in is the only requirement.
UpdatePreferencesRequest.title: UpdatePreferencesRequest

UpdateProductRequest.description: A Product's new details. An empty slug is generated again from the name.
UpdateProductRequest.title: UpdateProductRequest

UpdateShippingZoneRequest.description: A Shipping zone's new name and the full list of places it covers (replacing the old one).
UpdateShippingZoneRequest.title: UpdateShippingZoneRequest

UpdateStoreSettingsRequest.description:
The whole settings form, saved at once. Only the Admin (settings.manage) may change it.
The limits keep every value one the other modules can work with: VAT in cents of a
percent, whole-day Return windows, whole-unit thresholds.
UpdateStoreSettingsRequest.title: UpdateStoreSettingsRequest

UpdateUserRequest.description:
A User's new name, email and Role. The password is never set here: the User changes
their own in their profile.
UpdateUserRequest.title: UpdateUserRequest

UpdateVariantsRequest.description:
New values for some of a Product's Variants, saved together: SKU, price, Average cost
and Low-stock threshold (empty follows the store default). A SKU must be unique among
all Variants; Variants in the same save may swap SKUs.
UpdateVariantsRequest.title: UpdateVariantsRequest

UpdateWarehouseRequest.description: A Warehouse's new name, code, address and active state.
UpdateWarehouseRequest.title: UpdateWarehouseRequest

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
